runtime.fresh_source_bytecode: Only inventory source bytes were copied; no source pyc existed. PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 applied to every fresh subprocess; source pyc presence recorded before/after actual pytest. This does not claim -B prevents reading pre-existing pyc.

runtime.comparison_to_history: Historical .venv-dynamic was deleted. All three current controls use the same documented existing CPU cache profile, not relabeled as historical profile.

public_contract_evidence.statement: Bytes should be converted to proper text instead of their Python bytes representation; demonstrated through public Schema.dump/fields.String.
public_contract_evidence.existing_source_api: utils.ensure_text_type decodes bytes using utf-8 and returns str.
public_contract_evidence.wrong_replacement: return str(value)[2:-1] if isinstance(value, bytes) else str(value)
public_contract_evidence.why_natural_partial_repair: Removes bytes repr exterior for simple ASCII but preserves Python escape notation inside. No oracle constant/call-stack logic.
public_contract_evidence.behavior_examples: ASCII newline; ASCII with both quote characters; valid UTF8. Expected text comes from actual UTF8 decode, not from an added oracle.

import sys,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from marshmallow import Schema,fields
import marshmallow.fields as fm
p=Path(fm.__file__).resolve();assert p==Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve();assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sys.argv[2]
class S(Schema):text=fields.String()
s=S();examples=[('ASCII newline',b'line1\nline2'),('ASCII quotes',b'a\'b"c'),('UTF8',bytes.fromhex('c3a9'))]
rows=[]
for label,value in examples:
 expected=value.decode('utf-8');actual=s.dump({'text':value})['text'];rows.append({'label':label,'input_hex':value.hex(),'bytes_repr':repr(value),'expected_decoded_text':expected,'expected_text_repr':repr(expected),'actual_text':actual,'actual_text_repr':repr(actual),'exact_decoded_text':actual==expected})
print(json.dumps({'fields_file':str(p),'fields_sha256':sys.argv[2],'observations':rows},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
